snippet.title: World of Tanks: Update 2.0 Cinematic Trailer | gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Another chapter is coming, Commanders. The ground is shaking. Update 2.0 is just around the corner. Are you ready? 
 
Watch what we've been cooking up in the Update Overview now. There is a lot to unpack! ➡️ https://youtu.be/FTEkzHeiafg
 
You can't miss this. Be in position on September 3! More info ➡️ https://tanks.ly/3Jjskg3

To keep up to date with our latest development, contests and events visit http://worldoftanks.eu and http://worldoftanks.com

Create a World of Tanks account on https://worldoftanks.eu/dropbears and try out iconic historical tanks such as Tiger 131, Sherman Firefly & T-34/85M!
You can also tell your friends and share the invite code DROPBEARS.
